title: Quản lý chất thải rắn và chất thải nguy hại

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of solid waste and hazardous waste, their characteristics, and management principles.
Analyze the functional segments of solid waste management systems.
Apply sustainable and community-based solid waste management approaches.
Manage and handle hazardous waste effectively.
Conduct research, identify, and analyze practical issues in solid waste and hazardous waste management.
Work individually and in groups to solve problems and present findings.
Prepare and deliver effective presentations on solid waste management topics.
Analyze and solve practical problems in solid waste management.
Understand the environmental impacts of solid waste and hazardous waste management.
Evaluate economic aspects of solid waste management systems.
Engage communities in solid waste management practices.
Analyze policies and regulations related to solid waste and hazardous waste management.
